section_summary.extract_value: This section presents the results of Level-2 HGLM analyses testing several hypotheses related to team adaptation. It discusses the main effects and moderation effects of cognitive ability, learning orientation, and performance orientation on role structure adaptation. Specifically, Hypothesis 6, concerning the moderation of goal difficulty and role structure adaptation by performance orientation, was supported with a coefficient of -2.415.
